summary: Corruption of the Remaining Lifetime field in an IS-IS Link State PDU can go undetected, which may cause or worsen flooding storms and can also be used for denial of service. This proposed standard defines a backwards-compatible solution.

eli5.summary: If the clock on a note gets scribbled over, nobody notices and the note spreads wrongly. This adds a check so a damaged or tampered timer in routing messages gets caught.
